verdict.rationale: Aleph documents its own team and user permissions that control access to sensitive data (aleph-docs-18) and claims fine-grained permissions (aleph-docs-25). Its budget-planning page targets budget owners collaboratively updating their budgets (aleph-docs-26). However, nothing explicitly shows scoping access by department or dimension so an owner sees and edits only their own numbers. Missing for 10: explicit department/dimension-level data scoping, separate view vs. edit rights per budget owner, detailed permission docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
